comments.value: Upvote for Bool for sure, sometimes simplicity is great!
@{5a06876866e3d66494839796|full_name}: Yeah simplifying the process is also what will get more people hooked on it

Sounds really nice.
If available, we no longer need an Animator Controller layer which proxies value to Expression Parameter!
@{5a06876866e3d66494839796|full_name}: I'm surprised Bool wasn't the default, considering all that really matters for 99% of use cases is gonna be "Is this being touched? Yes/No"

And I didnt know it had this limitation. Ive been pulling my hair out yesterday since it didnt want to send the values from my receivers. It didnt help that it worked using bools in playmode but not ingame. I should have read the documentation more..
Actually given the nature of how they're being used;  Any chance we could get Triggers for this too?
This would be much easier for simple stuff.
This was implemented in a previous Open Beta update!
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Was it though? We can only send bools and 0 or 1 for ints...

@{5ba7e0881a53843243b76790|full_name}: It was. There is no in-between state for contacts-- either you're touching it, or you're not.
If you need to set a different value, you should use a Parameter Driver.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I think it would still be nice to directly set the value (whatever is specified) via the contact. It would streamline a lot of stuff.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: That's just making more work for something that could be done directly though.  If I have, say, a keyboard I want to poke on that does different toggles, it'd be far easier having them all on the same Int and swap among them depending on what I poke.
@{5e89d0822aedbc56a3155d12|full_name}: it would also be great to have a toggle for sync parameter directly tbh

details: It would be super nice to have the Contact Receiver able to drive an Int or a bool!
title: [1181] Ints / Bools for Contact Receivers
